notes: Round 1, no open findings. Inputs: peers NVDA/AVGO/MRVL/INTC; WACC 10.5%; terminal growth 3.0%; revenue growth years 2-5 of 25/18/12/8%; FCF margins of 18/20/21/22/22%; dcf_weight 0.6. Pre-check (my own run of the code's dcf function on the assumptions.json NTM revenue of about $72.6B; not the official compute): terminal value about 75% of EV (below 80%), DCF about $195/share. The peer EV/Sales value (median of about 16.3x applied to TTM revenue) is about $450/share. DCF and peer values diverge widely: the last close ($483.90, 2026-11-03) implies growth and/or margins well above our explicit five-year forecast. Inputs were chosen on their merits and not tuned to a target price or rating; the gen-lead and critics should expect the blended target to sit well below the price. Net cash: mapped cash $7,404M + short-term investments $8,372M - debt $7,079M = about $8.7B. Mapping check: long-term marketable equity investments (including warrants) and non-marketable equity securities sit in 'Other non-current assets' ($10,020M in total, which also includes other items; periodic.txt Note 8), and there are $1.84B of long-term operating lease liabilities. Both are excluded from net cash, consistent with the catalog lines. I do not consider this a material omission relative to a market cap of roughly $790B (<1.5% even at the full other-non-current-assets balance), so I am not routing it to gen-mapping. Also not adjusted: $5.1B of equity-investment commitments plus a $1.0B public equity investment made in October 2026 (periodic.txt Note 11; after period end). The risk-free rate, ERP and beta behind the WACC are analyst assumptions, not snapshot facts.
